SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch S.S.25. D. 4136.
REPORT
Date 17th Nov, 1932.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTER）

Subject (in full) Indecent Publication: Accused Fined $50.

Made by ________ and ________ Forwarded by C. D. I. Prince

Sir,
Wang Wei Zien 黄慧泉 Editor of the "Shanghai People's
Daily News 市民報 who was charged with the publication of
an indecent article mentioned in the attached, appeared at
the Shanghai Special District Court on November 17, when
he was fined $50.

（签名）
C.D.I.

Officer i/c Special Branch

（手写批注：File / 9/5 / 18.11.32）

报告
日期：1932年11月17日。
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. & S. B. 登记簿）

主题（全称）淫秽出版物：被告被罚款50元。

由 ________ 和 ________ 制作，经 C. D. I. Prince 转呈

先生，
《市民报》（Shanghai People's Daily News）编辑黄慧泉（Wang Wei Zien）因刊登附件中提及的淫秽文章而被指控，于11月17日出庭上海特区法院，被判罚款50元。

（签名）
C.D.I.

特别处主管警官

（手写批注：归档 / 9/5 / 1932年11月18日）

（手写批注：参见 Louza 首次调查报告 2706/32。）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. D. REGISTRY
No. D 4156
Date 26 / 10 / 32

The "Shanghai People's Daily News" (市民报),
No. 120 Kweichow Road, publishes the following article
on October 25, 1932:-

Mr. Loh Ts-ziang and the 4th concubine
of a certain person went to bed. The "fighting" was
so serious that Loh employed his full strength in order
to overcome the woman. At one time "they fought"
with long spears and at another they used knives.
The engagement continued for three hours until the 4th
concubine begged for mercy. Loh then withdrew.
It was already dawn.

The passion of the 4th concubine had not
been satisfied for a long time since the policeman had
left her. In consequence, she enjoyed herself beyond
words over the skill of Loh Ts-ziang and considered Loh
as her living delight. They then entered into an
everlasting oath and after embracing each other went
into a sweet and sound sleep.

〔此处转录不清〕

C. & S. D. 登记处
编号 D 4156
日期：1932年10月26日

《市民报》（Shanghai People's Daily News），
地址：贵州路120号，于1932年10月25日刊登如下文章：-

罗子江（Loh Ts-ziang）先生与某人的四姨太同床共枕。“打斗”如此激烈，以至于罗使尽全身力气以制服该女子。一时“他们”用长矛“交战”，一时又动用刀具。这场“激战”持续了三个小时，直到四姨太求饶。罗随后退兵。此时天已破晓。

自从那名警察离开她后，四姨太的欲望长期未得到满足。因此，她对罗子江的技巧享受得难以言表，并将罗视为其活生生的快乐源泉。随后两人立下海誓山盟，相拥而眠，睡得香甜安稳。

〔此处转录不清〕
